'''Gren al'Mar''' is the blacksmith of [[Watch Hill]] in the [[Two Rivers]].

== Appearance ==
Gren is a husky young man with a bushy reddish-brown beard, and a permanently sullen expression.

== History ==
When the Two Rivers is attacked by [[Whitecloaks]] and [[Trollocs]], Gren notices [[Llana]] passing through the region.<ref name="RPG">''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>
